evaluation_basis: Assessed against its original goal: establish a real-market baseline and reject unjustified ML complexity; modern robustness gaps are limitations, not retroactive failure criteria.
original_objective: Run the first real CoinEx BTC/USDT 4h ML baseline against Buy & Hold and 24-bar momentum.

engineering_result.summary: Real public-market data, chronological holdout, friction assumptions and three executable baselines were produced.

scientific_result.summary: OHLCV-derived HistGradientBoosting plus P(up)>0.56 abstention did not demonstrate incremental value.

economic_result.summary: ML return -3.91%, Sharpe -3.48 and MDD -4.31%; momentum returned +11.46% and Buy & Hold +23.45% in the same short holdout.

limitations: No funding, on-chain or order-flow data
Simplified slippage and no market impact
contribution_to_next_version: Established mandatory simple baselines and motivated v0.2 event sampling, purging and stronger labels.
